{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.24

|gr1= Inventory

|descr= Remove virtual magazines from an object (e.g., ammo box). Virtual items can be selected in the [[Arsenal]].

|s1= [object, magClasses, removeGlobally] call [[BIS_fnc_removeVirtualMagazineCargo]]

|p1= object: [[Object]] - object from which items will be removed

|p2= magClasses: [[Boolean]], [[String]] or [[Array]] of [[String]]s - magazine classes

|p3= removeGlobally: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to remove items globally

|r1= [[Array]] of [[Array]]s of all virtual items in objects's space in format [items, weapons, magazines, backpacks]<!--:
* 0: [[Array]] - Items
* 1: [[Array]] - Weapons
* 2: [[Array]] - Magazines
* 3: [[Array]] - Backpacks
-->

|x1= <sqf>[BIS_ammoBox, ["class_1", "class_2"], true] call BIS_fnc_removeVirtualMagazineCargo;</sqf>

|seealso= [[Arsenal]] [[BIS_fnc_addVirtualBackpackCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_addVirtualItemCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_addVirtualMagazineCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_addVirtualWeaponCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_arsenal]] [[BIS_fnc_getVirtualBackpackCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_getVirtualItemCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_getVirtualMagazineCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_getVirtualWeaponCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_removeVirtualBackpackCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_removeVirtualItemCargo]] [[BIS_fnc_removeVirtualWeaponCargo]]
}}
